# stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer (Resource)

A trial period a price offers before it transitions to another price. `terraform destroy` archives the trial offer, because Stripe cannot delete one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_product" "gold" {
  name = "Gold plan"
}

resource "stripe_price" "trial" {
  product     = stripe_product.gold.id
  currency    = "usd"
  unit_amount = 100

  recurring = {
    interval = "month"
  }
}

resource "stripe_price" "full" {
  product     = stripe_product.gold.id
  currency    = "usd"
  unit_amount = 1000

  recurring = {
    interval = "month"
  }
}

resource "stripe_product_catalog_trial_offer" "first_month" {
  price    = stripe_price.trial.id
  nickname = "First month"

  duration = {
    type     = "relative"
    relative = { iterations = 1 }
  }

  end_behavior = {
    transition = { price = stripe_price.full.id }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `duration` (Attributes) Duration of one service period of the trial. Changing it replaces the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--duration))
- `end_behavior` (Attributes) Define behavior that occurs at the end of the trial. Changing it replaces the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_behavior))
- `price` (String) Price configuration during the trial period (amount, billing scheme, etc). Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the trial offer can be used for new subscriptions. Defaults to true.
- `nickname` (String) A brief description of the trial offer, hidden from customers. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

Required:

<a id="nestedatt--duration--relative"></a>
### Nested Schema for `duration.relative`

Required:

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

